theorem firstSurv_some {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} {l : List Nat} {z : Nat}
    (h : firstSurv s F₀ l = some z) : z ∈ l ∧ Survives s F₀ z :=
  ⟨List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h, by simpa using List.find?_some h⟩

/-- No element of a list without first surviving element survives (§73.4). -/
theorem firstSurv_none {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} {l : List Nat} (h : firstSurv s F₀ l = none) :
    ∀ w ∈ l, ¬ Survives s F₀ w := by
  intro w hw hs
  have := List.find?_eq_none.1 h w hw
  simp [hs] at this

/-- The first surviving strict ancestor (§73.4): an ancestor that survives, such that every
surviving ancestor is it or one of its own ancestors. -/
theorem firstSurv_ancs {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ z, firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs x) = some z →
      z ∈ s.ancs x ∧ Survives s F₀ z ∧
        ∀ w ∈ s.ancs x, Survives s F₀ w → w = z ∨ w ∈ s.ancs z
  | 0, _, h, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, z, hz => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hz; simp [firstSurv] at hz
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ : o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o := by
        rcases ancs_step ho with h | he
        · exact h
        · rw [he] at hz; simp [firstSurv] at hz
      rw [he] at hz ⊢
      by_cases hs : Survives s F₀ o
      · simp only [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (p := fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z))
          (by simpa using hs), Option.some.injEq] at hz
        subst hz
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_self .., hs, fun w hw' _ => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw' with rfl | hw'
        · exact .inl rfl
        · exact .inr hw'
      · simp only [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_neg (p := fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z))
          (by simpa using hs)] at hz
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := firstSurv_ancs n o (by omega) z hz
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1, h2, fun w hw' hws => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw' with rfl | hw'
        · exact absurd hws hs
        · exact h3 w hw' hws

/-! ## Authorities after `exitFrame` (§73 `ok` effect) -/

section Exit

variable {s : S3}

/-- Authority `j` after the exit (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exit_A_get (s : S3) (j : Nat) :
    (exitEff s).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map (exitG s s.F.tail j) := by
  simp [exitEff, getElem?_mapI]

/-- An authority after the exit comes from the authority of the same identity (§73). -/
theorem exit_get {j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : (exitEff s).A[j]? = some z) :
    ∃ z₀, s.A[j]? = some z₀ ∧ z = exitG s s.F.tail j z₀ := by

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex` (WC2 C13) registers an entry whose controller (`ControlOf`) need not be a leaf, while
`SyncInv.control` (WC2 C21.3 with the "synchronization-control leaf" of WC2 C12) requires one:
the `newMutex` case is proved under the explicit hypothesis `NewMutexLeaf`, and
`newMutex_breaks_control` shows that the hypothesis is needed.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j

theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg, ht, hb⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he, ht e he,
      hb e he⟩, hi.unique⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hu⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩

/-! ## Controller -/

theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : ∃ y hp m, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧
      y.holder = .place hp ∧ parentOf s.P hp = some m ∧
      (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp ∧ (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? = some ctl := by
  unfold ControlOf at h
  cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; simp at h
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at h
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => simp [hh] at h
    | place hp =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, hh] at h
      cases hm : parentOf s.P hp with
      | none => rw [hm] at h; cases h
      | some m =>
        rw [hm] at h
        by_cases hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp
        · rw [if_pos hk] at h; exact ⟨y, hp, m, rfl, hh, hm, hk, h⟩
        · rw [if_neg hk] at h; cases h

/-- The controller of a live entry is usable when the place holding `guarded` is (WC2 C12: the
fields of the mutex value share its owner and death marker, Spec 1 §49.2). -/
theorem control_usable {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hl : e.Live s) (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : s.flat.Usable ctl := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hh, hm, hk, hc⟩ := controlOf_spec h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya⟩ := hl
  have hy' : s.flat.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy'] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  have hu : s.flat.Usable hp := by have := hw.holders _ _ hy' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hc)).2
  have hpar : ∀ q, parentOf s.P q = some m → ∃ pl pm, s.P[q]? = some pl ∧ s.P[m]? = some pm ∧
      pm.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead m = s.dead q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [parentOf] at hq
    cases hpl : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at hq
      obtain ⟨pm, hpm, -, ho, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl m hpl hq
      exact ⟨pl, pm, hpl, hpm, ho, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨ph, pm, hph, hpm, ho, hd⟩ := hpar hp hm
  obtain ⟨pc, pm', hpc, hpm', ho', hd'⟩ := hpar ctl hcm
  rw [hpm] at hpm'; cases hpm'
  exact S3.Usable.of_same hu hph hpc (by rw [← ho', ho]) (by
    show s.dead ctl = s.dead hp; rw [← hd', hd])

end SyncPreserveAux

end Ern.Concurrency

  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, ha, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩

theorem Skel.afp (hsk : Skel s s') {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    s'.flat.afp x = s.flat.afp x := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hx hsk.len)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hf, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  rw [afp_of hy', afp_of hy, hf]

theorem Skel.covering (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length) (hj : j < s.A.length)
    (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : CoveringDesc s g j := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, hact, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hsk.ancsSub j hj g hanc, hsk.active hj hact, l, by rwa [← hsk.afp hj],
    by rwa [← hsk.afp hg]⟩

/-- A covering descendant created by the step comes from a covering descendant of the state
before, unless it is derived directly from `g` (WC2 C22). -/
theorem Skel.covering_new (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length)
    (hj : s.A.length ≤ j) (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : ∃ y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.origin = some o ∧ (g = o ∨ CoveringDesc s g o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  have hy'' : s'.A[j]? = some y' := hy'
  rcases hsk.new j y' hy'' hj with ho | ⟨o, ho, hoA, hoa, hfp, hanc'⟩
  · have : s'.flat.org j = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hanc; simp at hanc
  · refine ⟨y', o, hy'', ho, ?_, hanc'⟩
    rw [hanc'] at hanc
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hanc with rfl | hanc
    · exact .inl rfl
    · refine .inr ⟨hanc, hoa, l, hfp l (by rwa [afp_of hy''] at hl1), ?_⟩
      rwa [← hsk.afp hg]

end SkelLemmas

/-- One entry keeps its clauses across a step with an unchanged registry record (WC2 C21.1–C21.3,
C22, auxiliaries). `hsrc`: no authority added by the step is derived directly from `guarded`
(from `Encap`); `hhold`: a place-held `guarded` stays place-held; `hctl`: the controller stays
a leaf; `hw'`: `WF3` after the step (theorem 2). -/
theorem entry_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (he : EntryOK L s e)
    (hsrc : e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o →
      o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y → s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' →
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : EntryOK L s' e := by
  have hb := he.bound
  have hlive : e.Live s' → e.Live s := hsk.active hb
  refine ⟨fun hl => ?_, fun hl g₀ hg₀ => ?_, fun hl => ?_, fun hl hn => ?_, fun hl g₀ hg₀ ha₀ => ?_,
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hsk.len⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    have hy'' : s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' := hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := hsk.old _ y' hy'' hb
    have h1 := he.guarded (hlive ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩)
    simp only [OptP, hy] at h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hhold ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ y y' hy hy'' h1.2
    simp only [OptP, hy'']
    refine ⟨hm ▸ h1.1, ?_⟩
    have := hw'.holders _ y' hy' ya'
    rw [hq] at this ⊢; exact this
  · have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
    unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
    · rename_i z hz
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_getElem? hz) hsk.len)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hf, -, -, ho⟩ := hsk.old g₀ z' hz' (lt_of_getElem? hz)
      rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
      simp only [OptP, hz']
      refine ⟨ho _ h2.1 hl, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [hf, hsk.afp hb]; exact h2.2 l
    · exact h2.elim
  · have h3 := he.control (hlive hl)
    unfold OptP at h3; split at h3
    · rename_i ctl hc
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc', hleaf'⟩ := hctl hl ctl hc h3.2
      simp only [OptP, hc']
      exact ⟨SyncPreserveAux.control_usable hw' hl hc', hleaf'⟩
    · exact h3.elim
  · intro j hj hcov
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn j (List.mem_range.2 hjA) (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, -⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho rfl
      · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn o (List.mem_range.2 (active_lt hcov'.2.1)) hcov'
  · intro j hcov
    have hg₀A : g₀ < s.A.length := by
      have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
      unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact h2.elim
    have ha₀' := hsk.active hg₀A ha₀
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' j (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov) with rfl | h
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr (hsk.ancsKeep j hjA hcov.2.1 g₀ h ha₀)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, hanc⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact absurd rfl (hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho)
      · rw [hanc]
        rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' o hcov' with rfl | h
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-- Uniqueness across a step with an unchanged registry (WC2 C21.5): liveness only decreases. -/
theorem uniq_step {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s') (hb : RegBound s reg)
    (hu : Uniq s reg) : Uniq s' reg := fun i j e e' hi hj hl hl' hg =>
  hu i j e e' hi hj (hsk.active (hb e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)) hl)
    (hsk.active (hb e' (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)) hl') hg

/-- A step with an unchanged registry preserves `SyncState`, given the per-entry hypotheses of
`entry_step`. -/
theorem kernel_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y →
      s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' → PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨he, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hst
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun e hm => entry_step hsk hw' (he e hm) (hsrc e hm) (hhold e hm)
    (hctl e hm), uniq_step hsk (fun e hm => (he e hm).bound) hu⟩

end SyncPreserveAux
